explicit_validation.explanation: Both LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation are conducted but they assess different criteria (modality reliance vs caption quality) on different sets of data, with no quantitative or qualitative comparison between the two methods

prompts.notes: Paper mentions using Gemini as an external judge for modality reliance assessment but does not provide the exact prompt text

guidelines.notes: Appendix D provides detailed scoring criteria for three dimensions (Sentence Fluency, Colloquial Tone, Contextual Alignment) with 5-point Likert scale definitions

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM-as-a-judge evaluates modality reliance in geolocation inferences, while human evaluation assesses generated caption quality and human-likeness - completely different evaluation objectives
